topic: Updating cluster traffic calculations for accounts
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on refining the calculation of cluster traffic, particularly for accounts 7600 and 7847. Initially, a rule was proposed to limit the recalculation only to malls with five or more sensors.

Later, issues were identified regarding frequency calculations in beta analytics, noting that the base frequency derived from session-to-unique ratios resulted in unusually high numbers for cluster data compared to standard 'city' data. This discrepancy required further investigation and potential manual coefficient adjustments.

The primary task involved applying a specific frequency formula (previously provided) to account 7847 on staging, and then implementing the updated cluster traffic calculation for both 2022 and 2023 years on the beta environment.
decisions: The cluster traffic recalculation scope was narrowed down to malls with five or more sensors.
A specific frequency formula must be applied to account 7847 on staging.
The updated cluster traffic calculation for accounts 7600 and 7847 (for 2022 and 2023) will be implemented on the beta environment.
action_items: Reviewing the frequency discrepancy in beta analytics, potentially requiring manual coefficient adjustments.
The developer confirmed completion of applying the formula to account 7847 (staging).
The updated cluster traffic calculation for 2022 and 2023 was completed on the beta environment.
